## Who we are

### Align Technology is a global medical device company that is changing lives through better
### smiles. We reimagine and reinvent the way orthodontic and restorative treatment is presented and
### delivered to millions of people around the world.

The Invisalign® System is the most advanced clear aligner system in the world, trusted by over 22
million people worldwide to improve their smiles.

[Learn more][17]

iTero™ intraoral scanners can propel today's dental practice into the future by enhancing the
patient experience and elevating clinical precision.

[Learn more][18]

 

## Key metrics

# ~$4.1B

#### Annualized net revenues

# ~22.8M

#### Invisalign® Patients, including ~6.8M teens and kids

# 2,319

#### Active patents

# +20K

#### Global Employees

[Joe Hogan, President and CEO]

### CEO 2026 Letter to Shareholders

As I reflect on fiscal 2025, I am proud of how Align navigated a year that demanded focus,
resilience, and disciplined execution. The operating environment remained uneven across regions,
consumer demand was pressured in parts of the world, and we made difficult organizational decisions
to better position the company for the future. Yet through these challenges, our teams stayed
anchored to what matters most—serving doctors and their patients—and delivered a strong finish to
the year.

[Link to CEO letter][19]

communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

corporate social responsibility program.

to manage your schedule.

Teach: An Arini implementation Engineer onboards your practice by customizing your scheduling rules,
verbiage, call flow, and more.
‍

Test: You test your custom instance and make edits as you wish.
‍

Go live: We start taking real patients calls, monitor your calls, and make sure you have a smooth
transition!

providers, we have practices using Weave, Mango, GoTo, Jive, RevenueWealth PBX, Telco and more.

South Pasadena. Over time, our practice grew in ways our old space could no longer support, and this
move allows us to better serve you with room to breathe, grow, and thrive together.

Our new office is located on historic Mission St. and is modern and thoughtfully designed, offering
the latest amenities to make your visits more comfortable and your care more seamless. From a clean,

welcoming environment. We focus on ensuring that you, and your child, leave our office with a
healthy and beautiful smile. With over 35 years of experience and the latest in dental technology,
our team is equipped to provide the best dental care possible.

Dr. Byrne and Dr. Byrne the junior, have helped thousands of patients with medical discomfort and
cosmetic repairs. From pediatric care, to implant restorations providing excellent care is all in a
days work for these generational dentists. Providing our patients with the smile they’ve always
wanted is the reason our patients love us and continue to return for years and generation to come.

## About Byrne Family Dentistry

Steven M. Byrne was born and raised in South Louisville. He graduated from WKU and then the
University of Louisville School of Dentistry in 1986. He began practicing in La Grange in 1987,
where he and wife Merry raised their family. They have two boys, Jake and Zachary. Jake, a 2009
graduate of WKU and the University of Kentucky College of Medicine in 2013, is a practicing
psychiatrist in Chicago, IL. Zachary, a 2011 graduate of WKU and the University of Louisville School
of Dentistry in 2017, joined Byrne Family Dentistry after graduation. Zachary is married to his
wife, Amy, and they have a son named Beau.

Together, Dr. Steve and Dr. Zach are committed to serving their community, which Byrne Family
Dentistry has done for more than 30 years. Both are members of the American Dental Association,
Kentucky Dental Association, and Louisville Dental Society. The doctors and their amazingly
talented, friendly, and loyal staff are here to help with any of your dental needs.

## Current Issue
* #### [Facial Trauma Prevention in Adults and Children][62]
  * Elizabeth Powell
  * Azza T. Ahmed
  * Scott Spreat
  
  Published online: April 29, 2026
  * [Preview Hide Preview][63]
  Facial trauma is a growing public health concern with substantial physical, psychological, and
  financial consequences. Injuries arise from multiple causes, including motor vehicle accidents,
  falls, assaults, and sports, and their impact differs across age, gender, and social groups. Older
  adults are increasingly affected by fall-related trauma, while women are more likely to experience
  violence-related injuries. Children and individuals with disabilities also face unique risks that
  require targeted approaches. Preventive strategies such as helmet use, seatbelts, fall-prevention
  programs, and early recognition of domestic violence are essential. Interdisciplinary
  collaboration and community-based initiatives remain central to reducing the burden of facial
  trauma.
* #### [Adopting a Trauma-Informed Framework in Clinical Practice][64]
  * Puhan He
  * Neeraj Panchal
  
  Published online: May 6, 2026
  * [Preview Hide Preview][65]
  Trauma, including both historical adversity and acute injury, is highly prevalent in the general
  population. Over 50% of adults report adverse childhood experiences, and surgical patients
  frequently present with unaddressed psychological distress, which is significantly compounded by
  maxillofacial injuries and the potentially triggering nature of the care environment. Standard
  biomedical training typically lacks the necessary competencies for diagnosing, preventing, and
  managing these complex psychosocial needs. This review proposes and details a comprehensive,
  evidence-based framework for integrating trauma-informed care into practice to prevent patient
  retraumatization and improve long-term outcomes.

## ***We Can’t Wait To Meet You!***

## THE DENISON DIFFERENCE

Denison Family & Cosmetic Dentistry provides compassionate, comprehensive dental care in [Newport
News, VA][33]. Whether you are looking for general preventive care or are in need of cosmetic
treatments, dentures or sleep apnea treatment, we offer a full range of dental services. From the
minute you walk into our dental office you will notice a difference at Denison Dentistry. Our
Newport News dentist, John Denison, D.D.S. and his team care about you and your family, and we’re
here to help you achieve your healthiest, brightest smile. Denison Dentistry is part of the
[Atlantic Dental Care][34] Group, which is a group of local dentists and dental offices in Hampton
Roads that share a vision to provide quality care and are committed to helping the community and
their patients.

## MEET YOUR NEWPORT NEWS DENTIST
## DR. JOHN DENISON

Dr. Denison earned his Bachelor of Science in Biology at Florida State University and went on to
pursue his Doctor of Dental Surgery from the Medical College of Virginia School of Dentistry. Dr.
Denison places a strong emphasis on continuing education and he and his staff have attended many
courses regarding state-of-the-art treatments in dentistry, including extensive training in
Cosmetic, Restorative and Computerized Dentistry. He has been utilizing the state-of-the-art Cerec
CAD/CAM Instrument for over 15 years. Dr. Denison has also trained in the use of oral appliances for
sleep apnea.

Dr. Denison believes that going to dental school was one of the best decisions he has ever made. He
loves all aspects of his job. He enjoys working with people, running the business and doing the
dentistry. He became involved in dentistry after realizing it would allow him to combine his
creative side and his scientific knowledge. One of his favorite parts of the job is seeing the
finished results of treatments that transform a person from having poor oral health to having a
beautiful functional smile. Dr. Denison finds it so rewarding to see that patient’s reaction when
they first see and realize the results.

# Who We Are

Envista is a global family of more than 30 trusted dental brands, united by a shared purpose: to
partner with professionals to improve lives. Envista helps its partners deliver the best possible
patient care through industry-leading products, solutions, and technology.

The Envista portfolio of brands is dedicated to supporting, expanding, and improving how dental
professionals care for their patients. Focused on innovation and the future of the digital
landscape, we provide quality products and solutions for the dental office and beyond.

From digital consultation and modeling tools to superior equipment and surgical instruments, Envista
companies support dental professionals at every patient interaction, with increasingly integrated
digital workflows. Our comprehensive training and education programs offer career-spanning

## Frequently Asked Questions About Finding Manufacturers

### How do I find a manufacturer for my product?

Finding the right manufacturer starts with knowing exactly what you need. Define your product
specifications, target price point, and required certifications before you begin outreach. From
there, search by product category on a B2B sourcing platform like Find My Manufacturer, where you
can filter manufacturers by certifications, minimum order quantity, location, and production
capability.

Cross-reference any manufacturer you find across multiple sources, review their profile for
verifiable details, and always request a sample before committing to a full production run.
Referrals from industry contacts and trade show connections can also surface manufacturers who do
not actively advertise online.

The sourcing process typically takes 4 to 12 weeks from first contact to confirmed partner,
depending on your product category and customization requirements.

### How much does it cost to work with a private label or contract manufacturer?

Manufacturing costs vary widely based on product category, order volume, customization level,
material inputs, and the manufacturer’s location. For private label products, costs generally
include a per-unit production fee, packaging and labeling costs, and in some cases a setup or
tooling fee for custom molds or packaging formats. For contract manufacturing, additional costs may
include formulation development, testing, and regulatory compliance depending on the product
category.

Most manufacturers set a minimum order quantity (MOQ) that directly affects your per-unit cost –
higher volumes consistently reduce the cost per unit. As a benchmark, supplement private label MOQs
typically start around 1,000 to 2,500 units, apparel manufacturers often start at 300 to 500 pieces
per style, and food manufacturing MOQs vary from 500 to 5,000 units depending on the format.

The most reliable way to understand real costs for your specific product is to submit quote requests
to multiple manufacturers and compare. Find My Manufacturer allows you to do this directly, free,
with no broker fees or commission

that takes time to understand you, and a philosophy that puts your lifetime oral health first. From
advanced comfort amenities to in-depth consultations for complex cases, our approach is built around
clarity, trust, and long-term solutions. [Contact our office][46] or book your first appointment
online!

### Our Dental Services

At Implant Center of Miami, we are proud to provide a multitude of restorative, cosmetic, and
preventative dental services:

[[Dental implants]][82]

### [Dental Implants][83]

Dental implants are strong, durable, and natural-looking teeth replacements that can last for 20
years or more with the proper care. We offer dental implants for only $1789!

[ Learn More ][84]
[[Dentures]][85]

### [Dentures][86]

Dentures are essentially false teeth that are custom made to fit your mouth perfectly. They can be
used to replace a single tooth, multiple teeth, or even a full set of teeth.

[ Learn More ][87]
[[Invisalign®]][88]

### [Invisalign®][89]

Invisalign® is clear, custom, plastic aligners created to align a patient's teeth over the span of a
few months or years. This treatment is known to be a popular and effective solution!

[ Learn More ][90]
[[BOTOX® dentistry]][91]

### [BOTOX® Dentistry][92]

BOTOX® dentistry is the use of botulinum toxin to temporarily reduce or eliminate wrinkles in the
facial area. It can also be used to treat TMJ disorders and teeth grinding.

[ Learn More ][93]
[[Emergency]][94]

### [Emergency Services][95]

There are a few different types of dental emergencies that require different types of treatment. If
you have a tooth that has been knocked out or a toothache, come see us!

[ Learn More ][96]
[[Cosmetic]][97]

### [Cosmetic Dentistry][98]

Cosmetic dentistry is about improving the function of your teeth in a way that also leaves your
pearly whites looking bright and beautiful. From whitening to veneers, we do it all!

## Health Beyond Smiles

We believe dental care should do more than just make your teeth look good. At Metro Dental, we focus
on prevention, finding the root of the problem before it affects your health.

Misaligned teeth can shift your jaw, narrow your airway, affect digestion, and even strain your
posture. Poor oral health is also linked to heart disease and inflammation.

We use advanced diagnostics and a well-trained team in our dental clinics to catch issues early
before they become bigger problems that impact your health.

[Learn More][34]

even easier breathing.

clinics, and also ensure that you are choosing licensed and qualified professional.

dentist. However, there are certain cases and dental procedures that may require professional

### You deserve a beautiful smile

In our practice, you will discover contemporary dental care designed for your complete satisfaction.
We believe that teeth should look great, function properly, and withstand the rigors of daily life.
Dr. Joseph Wetherhold and the team at Alta Dental of Maine combine the science of restoring teeth
with artistic vision in cosmetic dentistry to produce strong, beautiful smiles.

### The History Of Dental Care

The history of dental care is as rich and fascinating as the stories behind every smile. Imagine
living thousands of years ago, when the first "dentists" were more like brave experimenters with
rudimentary tools. In ancient Egypt, they were already filling cavities and creating prosthetic
teeth with impressive ingenuity. Fast forward to ancient Greece and Rome, where thinkers like
Hippocrates were studying oral health and crafting the earliest versions of dental care techniques.
It’s almost like the ancient world was writing the first chapters of a book we’re still reading
today—filled with trial, error, and remarkable breakthroughs.

As time marched on, dental care evolved from a crude necessity to an advanced science. By the Middle
Ages, barber-surgeons were pulling double duty, cutting hair and extracting teeth, often in the same
sitting. Then came the Renaissance, a time of rebirth—

## **A New Chapter in South Pasadena**

After many cherished years in our Altadena office, we are excited to welcome you to our new home in
South Pasadena. Over time, our practice grew in ways our old space could no longer support, and this
move allows us to better serve you with room to breathe, grow, and thrive together.

Our new office is located on historic Mission St. and is modern and thoughtfully designed, offering
the latest amenities to make your visits more comfortable and your care more seamless. From a clean,
bright environment to advanced technology that supports exceptional dentistry, every detail reflects
our dedication to giving you the very best.

This transition also represents a fresh start following the Eaton Fire. That season reminded us of
the strength of our community and the importance of resilience. We are deeply grateful for the
support of our community and look forward to moving ahead with renewed purpose and energy.

Most of all, we look forward to welcoming you into our new space — a place where you and your family
can feel at home, and where we can continue building lasting connections rooted in trust,
compassion, and excellent care.  We hope to see you very soon!

## Comfortable Dentistry in South Pasadena

### Down-to-Earth, Up-to-Date Care

At our office, we take an educational approach to dental care because our goal is to empower
patients of all ages to maintain optimal oral health. We offer more than just single-tooth
dentistry, and if you have a dental issue we treat the underlying cause rather than just the
symptoms. At Arroyo Haven Dentistry, we’re proud to offer comprehensive care for your total smile
and your entire family! Call us today for quality dental care in South Pasadena!

[[A picture of an orange background with the words aroyo haven.]][27]

## **Our Mission at Arroyo Haven Dentistry**

Our Mission is to provide the highest quality of care and education, personalized to each
individual’s needs. We treat everyone (patients and team members) in our safe space with kindness,
compassion, patience, humility, and respect. We welcome open communication and transparency in what
we do.

## Our Vision

To provide our patients a dental experience that promotes a lifelong relationship built on trust,
confidence, and quality of work.

We are committed to being lifelong learners, evolving and growing in our professional skills through
continuing education.

We dedicate ourselves to be the best for each other and those we care for.

#### Frenectomies

Watching your infant struggle to breastfeed/bottle feed, or experiencing your own discomfort while
breastfeeding can be overwhelming. If a tongue tie procedure is necessary, Dr. Bethany utilizes a
CO2 laser to provide a gentle release. The short procedure gives your baby the opportunity for a
better feeding experience and more.

[Learn More][28][Find
Relief][29]

#### Implants

Missing teeth can negatively affect more than just the aesthetics of your smile. Tooth loss can lead
to other dental issues like shifting teeth and jaw bone resorption. Dental implants are the only
replacement option that prevent these issues and completely restore your smile.

‍


[Replace Missing Teeth][30][Learn More][31]

#### Crowns

If your tooth has been damaged by decay or cracked in an oral injury, a dental crown can repair it
and prevent further damage. Crowns are meant to cover up the exterior surface of your tooth all the
way down to the gumline, and they look and feel completely natural.


‍


[Restore Tooth Structure][32][Learn More][33]

#### Fillings

Even with the best oral hygiene routine, cavities can still occur. If your teeth have been affected
by decay, we offer natural-looking composite fillings to repair the damage and get you back to
smiling again. If you suspect that you have a cavity, call today to book a visit for a filling!

‍


[Treat
Cavities][34][Learn More][35]

## Welcome to Byrne Family Dentistry

At Byrne Family Dentistry, our top priority is to provide professional dental care in a warm and
welcoming environment. We focus on ensuring that you, and your child, leave our office with a
healthy and beautiful smile. With over 35 years of experience and the latest in dental technology,
our team is equipped to provide the best dental care possible.

Dr. Byrne and Dr. Byrne the junior, have helped thousands of patients with medical discomfort and
cosmetic repairs. From pediatric care, to implant restorations providing excellent care is all in a
days work for these generational dentists. Providing our patients with the smile they’ve always
wanted is the reason our patients love us and continue to return for years and generation to come.

* #### [COSMETIC DENTISTRY][23]
  
  Physical appearance is the most obvious benefit, but your physical, emotional, and mental health
  is also improved thanks to cosmetic dentistry.
* #### [PEDIATRIC DENTISTRY][24]
  
  Preventing cavities and other problems at a young age will set your child down a path to having
  strong teeth and gums when they get older.
* #### [ROOT CANAL][25]
  
  A root canal involves removing the deteriorated pulp from the root of the tooth and stabilizing
  the tooth with filler.
* #### [PREVENTATIVE DENTISTRY][26]
  
  Prevent bacteria buildup and avoid tooth loss by scheduling routine professional cleanings and
  dental exams at an early age to keep your teeth, gums, and mouth as healthy as possible.
* #### [ORAL HYGIENE][27]
  
  You already know that maintaining good oral hygiene and scheduling teeth cleanings is important to
  keeping you teeth strong and healthy.
* #### [IMPLANT RESTORATION][28]
  
  It’s important to maintain your implants so they don’t damage your gums or other teeth. Contact us
  today if you feel any discomfort caused by your implants.

## About Byrne Family Dentistry

Steven M. Byrne was born and raised in South Louisville. He graduated from WKU and then the
University of Louisville School of Dentistry in 1986. He began practicing in La Grange in 1987,
where he and wife Merry raised their family. They have two boys, Jake and Zachary. Jake, a 2009
graduate of WKU and the University of Kentucky College of Medicine in 2013, is a practicing
psychiatrist in Chicago, IL. Zachary, a 2011 graduate of WKU and the University of Louisville School
of Dentistry in 2017, joined Byrne Family Dentistry after graduation. Zachary is married to his
wife, Amy, and they have a son named Beau.

Together, Dr. Steve and Dr. Zach are committed to serving their community, which Byrne Family
Dentistry has done for more than 30 years. Both are members of the American Dental Association,
Kentucky Dental Association, and Louisville Dental Society. The doctors and their amazingly
talented, friendly, and loyal staff are here to help with any of your dental needs.

## Current Issue
* #### [Facial Trauma Prevention in Adults and Children][62]
  * Elizabeth Powell
  * Azza T. Ahmed
  * Scott Spreat
  
  Published online: April 29, 2026
  * [Preview Hide Preview][63]
  Facial trauma is a growing public health concern with substantial physical, psychological, and
  financial consequences. Injuries arise from multiple causes, including motor vehicle accidents,
  falls, assaults, and sports, and their impact differs across age, gender, and social groups. Older
  adults are increasingly affected by fall-related trauma, while women are more likely to experience
  violence-related injuries. Children and individuals with disabilities also face unique risks that
  require targeted approaches. Preventive strategies such as helmet use, seatbelts, fall-prevention
  programs, and early recognition of domestic violence are essential. Interdisciplinary
  collaboration and community-based initiatives remain central to reducing the burden of facial
  trauma.
* #### [Adopting a Trauma-Informed Framework in Clinical Practice][64]
  * Puhan He
  * Neeraj Panchal
  
  Published online: May 6, 2026
  * [Preview Hide Preview][65]
  Trauma, including both historical adversity and acute injury, is highly prevalent in the general
  population. Over 50% of adults report adverse childhood experiences, and surgical patients
  frequently present with unaddressed psychological distress, which is significantly compounded by
  maxillofacial injuries and the potentially triggering nature of the care environment. Standard
  biomedical training typically lacks the necessary competencies for diagnosing, preventing, and
  managing these complex psychosocial needs. This review proposes and details a comprehensive,
  evidence-based framework for integrating trauma-informed care into practice to prevent patient
  retraumatization and improve long-term outcomes.

**Private label and contract manufacturing serve different needs. Here is how to know which one is

### Private Label Manufacturers

A private label manufacturer produces an existing or semi-custom product that you brand and sell

scratch.

### Contract Manufacturers

A contract manufacturer produces a product built entirely to your specifications. Best for brands
with a proprietary design, formula, or product that needs to be manufactured exactly as specified.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Finding Manufacturers

### How do I find a manufacturer for my product?

Finding the right manufacturer starts with knowing exactly what you need. Define your product
specifications, target price point, and required certifications before you begin outreach. From
there, search by product category on a B2B sourcing platform like Find My Manufacturer, where you
can filter manufacturers by certifications, minimum order quantity, location, and production
capability.

Cross-reference any manufacturer you find across multiple sources, review their profile for
verifiable details, and always request a sample before committing to a full production run.
Referrals from industry contacts and trade show connections can also surface manufacturers who do
not actively advertise online.

The sourcing process typically takes 4 to 12 weeks from first contact to confirmed partner,
depending on your product category and customization requirements.

### How much does it cost to work with a private label or contract manufacturer?

Manufacturing costs vary widely based on product category, order volume, customization level,
material inputs, and the manufacturer’s location. For private label products, costs generally
include a per-unit production fee, packaging and labeling costs, and in some cases a setup or
tooling fee for custom molds or packaging formats. For contract manufacturing, additional costs may
include formulation development, testing, and regulatory compliance depending on the product
category.

Most manufacturers set a minimum order quantity (MOQ) that directly affects your per-unit cost –
higher volumes consistently reduce the cost per unit. As a benchmark, supplement private label MOQs
typically start around 1,000 to 2,500 units, apparel manufacturers often start at 300 to 500 pieces
per style, and food manufacturing MOQs vary from 500 to 5,000 units depending on the format.

The most reliable way to understand real costs for your specific product is to submit quote requests
to multiple manufacturers and compare. Find My Manufacturer allows you to do this directly, free,
with no broker fees or commission

## Health Beyond Smiles

We believe dental care should do more than just make your teeth look good. At Metro Dental, we focus
on prevention, finding the root of the problem before it affects your health.

Misaligned teeth can shift your jaw, narrow your airway, affect digestion, and even strain your
posture. Poor oral health is also linked to heart disease and inflammation.

We use advanced diagnostics and a well-trained team in our dental clinics to catch issues early
before they become bigger problems that impact your health.

[Learn More][34]

furniture and a welcoming ambiance.]

## Invisalign

### 
###  Precision Meets Wellness

Invisalign,  the world’s most advanced clear aligner system, is backed by data from over 20 million
smiles and powered by AI-driven planning tools that move teeth with precision and purpose. This
isn’t just about straightening, it’s about improving your overall health.

Aligned teeth support better jaw position, more efficient chewing and digestion, clearer speech, and
even easier breathing.

As a Diamond Tier Provider and one of the top Invisalign clinics in the Philippines, Metro Dental
delivers expert care with a health-first approach you can trust. You can have confidence that our
dentists in Metro Manila are trained to help you achieve your perfect smile using state-of-the-art
technology.

Metro Dental has four conveniently located dentist clinics inside top malls across Metro Manila —
making it easy to find a dental clinic near you.

We’re open daily until 8:00 PM, including weekends and most holidays, so you can get the care you
need on your schedule. Whether you're booking a routine checkup or a more advanced consultation, our
dental clinics in Metro Manila are designed for convenience, comfort, and accessibility.

We believe every smile tells a story — let yours shine with confidence.

on prevention, finding the root of the problem before it affects your health.
